title: Declined Reschedule Calls Before a Failed Visit — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
A Ridgeline Installation Services customer who called ahead to move a visit, and whose reschedule request was declined, carries a reduced advance-call share of the failed-visit trip charge.

**Clause.** Advance-call share of the failed-visit trip charge: an advance call is the most recent customer reschedule request on the contract that was declined; when it was registered on the date of the failed visit the same-day call share of 0.75 applies, when it was registered one or more days before the failed visit the earlier-call share of 0.5 applies, and with no declined reschedule request registered on or before the failed visit the advance-call share is 1.

The failed-visit trip charge is multiplied by the advance-call share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the failed-visit trip charge is rounded, the failed-visit trip charge being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The failed visit** is the most recent visit recorded on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready.
- **Declined** is the status the reschedule request carries once it was decided against; requests that were submitted, approved, withdrawn or completed are not advance calls.
- The date that counts is the calendar date on which the declined request was registered.

| Most recent declined customer reschedule request | Advance-call share |
|---|---|
| registered on the date of the failed visit | 0.75 |
| registered 1 or more days before the failed visit | 0.5 |
| registered after the failed visit | 1 |
| none on the contract | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical failed visit on 12 May, trip charge of 129.00 before the share)

| Declined request registered | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 12 May | 0.75 | 96.75 |
| 9 May | 0.5 | 64.50 |
| no declined request | 1 | 129.00 |
